sources.entry: Dittofeed - Omni-channel customer engagement and messaging automation platform (alternative to Braze, Customer.io, Iterable). (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Dittofeed is an open-source, omni-channel customer engagement platform for sending broadcasts and automated event-based user journeys across email, push, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack and more.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a platform for messaging users across email, mobile push, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, and other channels. User data can be connected via Segment, Reverse ETL, or the Dittofeed API. Users can build segments with multiple operators, and design message templates in HTML/MJML or a low-code editor. Broadcasts and automated journeys are created through a GUI, with integrations to ESPs such as Sendgrid and Amazon SES. The dashboard tracks and analyzes message performance. Some embedding features (multi-tenancy, embedding, white-labeling) are described as part of a licensed closed-source codebase rather than the MIT-licensed core.
use_cases: send automated email journeys to users
build user segments for targeted messaging
self-hosted alternative to Braze or Customer.io
how_to_run: Follow the Docker Compose deployment walkthrough referenced in the README
Click 'Deploy to Render' and follow the prompts to deploy on Render
See the Contributing docs for running Dittofeed locally
stack: Prisma (being replaced by Drizzle per roadmap)
notable: Omni-channel messaging across email, push, SMS, WhatsApp, and Slack from one platform
Developer-focused: templates stored in git, branch-based workflows, and a testing SDK for CI
Embeddable Journey Builder, Segment Builder and Template Builder via iframe or headless React component
Low-code email template editor alongside HTML/MJML support
Self-hostable so PII stays in your own VPC
caveats: Multi-tenancy, embedding, and white-labeling are part of a licensed closed-source codebase; contact email support for details
Several roadmap items (identity resolution, analytics dashboard, LLM integration, Stripe integration, git-based testing) are in development or planned, not yet complete
Cloud trial is offered as an alternative to self-hosting
keywords: automate messages based on user events
